# Options

Second argument of `createCms(config, options)`.

| Option | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `database` | Drizzle Postgres database, or a function returning one (called on first use) |
| `table` | Table name, with `database`. Default `entries`. |
| `storage` | Your own `EntryStorage` instead of `database` ([Other ORMs](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/other-orms.md)) |
| `auth` | `{ password, secret }` for the built-in login, or an `AuthAdapter` ([Authentication](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/authentication.md)) |
| `media` | Image storage ([Image storage](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/image-storage.md)) |
| `adminPath`, `apiPath` | Default `/admin`, `/api/mnml`. Must match the route files. |
| `brand` | Name and logo of the sidebar and sign-in page: a string, `{ name, logo }`, or an (async) function returning either ([Brand and logo](#brand-and-logo)) |
| `icons` | Sidebar icons per key, e.g. `{ posts: <FileTextIcon /> }` |
| `pages` | Extra admin screens: `{ path, label, group?, icon?, render }`. Build with `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/admin`. |
| `listActions` | Your own actions in a collection list's bar, per key: `{ posts: [{ name, label, danger?, confirm?, run }] }` ([Bulk actions](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/drafts-and-publishing.md#bulk-actions)) |
| `editor` | Component from `editorProvider()`: extra extensions and buttons ([Extending the editor](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/editor.md)) |
| `ui` | Component from `uiProvider()`: your own Button, Select… in the admin ([Custom admin UI](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/custom-admin-ui.md)) |
| `mcp` | `{ tokens, adminTokens }`: MCP server for AI agents at `<apiPath>/mcp`, with tokens from env and/or the admin ([Agents](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/agents.md)) |
| `search` | `{ index, route }`: search over published content, `cms.search()` and a `search_content` MCP tool. `index` is your own `SearchIndex` (Postgres, pgvector, Mongo, Convex…); `route` opens a public search route ([Search](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/search.md)) |
| `cache` | `true` or `{ revalidate }` (seconds, default 3600): keeps published reads between requests, dropped on each save or delete. Off by default, recommended ([Caching](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/reading-content.md#caching)) |
| `revalidate` | After each save or delete, with `{ type, key, slug, by? }`. `by`: the agent token's name. |
| `ai` | `assistant({ model, tools?, name?, tone?, maxSteps?, store? })` from `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/ai`: the admin assistant, a chat panel that answers from your content and fills fields for the editor to review. `model` is an AI Gateway id (`'anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5'`) or any AI SDK model; needs the `ai` package ([Assistant](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/assistant.md)) |
| `onChange` | After the response (via `after()`) on each save or delete, e.g. to update a search index. Same change as `revalidate`. |

## Brand and logo

`brand` is the name in the sidebar and on the sign-in page. Give it an object to add your logo:

```ts
createCms(config, {
  brand: { name: 'Example', logo: '/logo.svg' },
});
```

`logo` is one of:

- A URL (a file in `public/`, or any absolute URL). Replaces the letter tile; the name stays beside it.
- `{ src, dark?, alt?, wordmark? }`. `dark` is shown in the admin's dark theme. `wordmark: true` hides the name and sizes the image by its height, for a logo that already contains it. `alt` defaults to empty, or to the name with `wordmark`.
- A React element, e.g. an inline SVG using `currentColor`.

If the image fails to load, the letter tile is shown. A plain string, or a function returning a string or object, works as before.

## In your own code

- `cms.isAdmin()`: checks the session in your routes. Works with the built-in login and adapters.
- `useAdmin()` from `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/admin` opens the admin's dialogs and toasts in custom admin pages:

```ts
const { confirm, alert, toast } = useAdmin();
await confirm({ title: 'Delete?', description: '…', confirmLabel: 'Delete', danger: true }); // true or false
toast({ title: 'Saved', tone: 'success' }); // tone: 'info' | 'success' | 'danger'; duration in ms, 0 = stays
```

## Admin UI components

Build `pages` with the admin's own controls from `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/admin`. To use your own instead, see [Custom admin UI](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/custom-admin-ui.md). Client components. No extra dependencies. Styled with `--mnml-*`.

| Component | Props |
| --- | --- |
| `Button` | `variant`, `size`, `disabled`, `onClick`, `children` |
| `Input`, `Textarea` | `id`, `value`, `onChange(value)`, `placeholder`, `disabled`, `invalid`. `Input` also `type` (number, date, datetime-local stay native, restyled). |
| `Select` | `id`, `value` (string or null), `onChange(value)`, `options: { value, label }[]`, `placeholder`, `clearable`, `invalid` |
| `Checkbox`, `Switch` | `id`, `checked`, `onChange(checked)`, `disabled`, `label` |
| `DatePicker` | `id`, `value` (`YYYY-MM-DD` or null), `onChange(value)`, `time` (adds a time box; value `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm`), `timeInCalendar` (with `time`: one box, time row in the calendar), `invalid` |
| `Tooltip` | `content`, `side`, one focusable child. Shows on hover and keyboard focus. |
| `Menu` | `label`, `items: { id, label, icon, checked, disabled, danger, keepOpen, onSelect }[]`, `trigger`, `className` |

- `onChange` gets the value, not the event.
- `Select`: full width; cap it with a `max-w-*` class. Arrows, Home/End, type-ahead, Enter, Escape. A value that isn't an option shows as "(unavailable)".
- `Menu`: a "more" icon button by default; pass `trigger` for your own content. Set `checked` for on/off items. Arrows wrap, Home/End, type-ahead, Escape.
- Label a control with `<label htmlFor={id}>`, the `label` prop, or `aria-label`.
- Prop types are exported: `SelectProps`, `CheckboxProps`, `MenuProps`, `MenuAction`, `ToastOptions`, …

```tsx
'use client';
import { Select, Switch, useAdmin } from '@n3wtou/mnml-cms/admin';

const { toast } = useAdmin();
<Select id="section" value={section} onChange={setSection} options={[{ value: 'posts', label: 'Posts' }]} />
<Switch checked={on} onChange={setOn} label="Confirm first" />
```

---

<!-- https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/custom-admin-ui.md -->

# Custom admin UI

Swap the admin's controls for your own, e.g. your shadcn Select. Slots you leave out keep the built-in ones.

Slots: `Button`, `Input`, `Textarea`, `Select`, `Checkbox`, `Switch`, `DatePicker`, `Tooltip`, `Menu`, `Markdown` (how the [assistant](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/assistant.md)'s replies are shown). Toasts stay built-in.

## Set up

A `'use client'` file maps your components to the slots:

```tsx filename="src/mnml/ui.tsx"
'use client';
import { uiProvider, type UiSlotProps } from '@n3wtou/mnml-cms/admin';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';

const NONE = '__none__'; // Radix items can't use '' as a value

function AdminSelect({ id, value, onChange, options, placeholder = '—', clearable, disabled, invalid, className, ...aria }: UiSlotProps['Select']) {
  const label = value === null ? placeholder : (options.find((o) => o.value === value)?.label ?? `${value} (unavailable)`);
  return (
    <Select value={value ?? (clearable ? NONE : '')} onValueChange={(v) => onChange(v === NONE ? null : v)} disabled={disabled}>
      <SelectTrigger id={id} aria-invalid={invalid || undefined} className={className} {...aria}>
        <SelectValue placeholder={placeholder}>{label}</SelectValue>
      </SelectTrigger>
      <SelectContent>
        {clearable && <SelectItem value={NONE}>{placeholder}</SelectItem>}
        {options.map((o) => (
          <SelectItem key={o.value} value={o.value}>{o.label}</SelectItem>
        ))}
      </SelectContent>
    </Select>
  );
}

export const AdminUi = uiProvider({ Select: AdminSelect });
```

Pass it to `createCms`:

```tsx filename="src/mnml/index.tsx"
import { AdminUi } from './ui';

export const cms = createCms(config, { /* … */ ui: AdminUi });
```

Custom admin `pages` that import `Select`, `Button`… from `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/admin` get your components too.

## What a slot gets

Props per slot: `UiSlotProps['Select']`, `UiSlotProps['Button']`, … (also `SelectProps`, `ButtonSlotProps`, …).

- Put `id` and the `aria-*` props on the focusable element. The field's `<label htmlFor>` names it through `id`.
- `invalid`: set `aria-invalid`.
- `onChange` gets the value, not the event.
- `Select`: `value` is `null` when empty. `clearable` adds an empty choice. Show a stored value that isn't an option.
- `Button`: also any `<button>` attribute (`className`, `aria-label`, `form`…). Variants `default`, `secondary`, `outline`, `ghost`, `danger`, `destructive`. Sizes `default`, `sm`, `icon`, `icon-sm`, `icon-xs`.
- `DatePicker`: `value` is `YYYY-MM-DD` or `null`. With `time`, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` in local time (the admin converts to and from UTC). Return the same shape from `onChange`.
- `DatePicker` `timeInCalendar`: the admin's datetime fields set it; one box with the time picked in the calendar. Your picker may ignore it. The admin's hour and minute lists are its own `Select`s, so your `Select` slot applies to them; portal its popover with `useAdminPortal()` so it sits above the calendar.
- `Tooltip`: `content`, `side`, one focusable child.
- `Menu`: `label`, `items` (`{ id, label, icon, checked, disabled, danger, keepOpen, onSelect }`; `keepOpen` leaves the menu open after the item runs, for on/off items), `trigger`, `className`.
- `Markdown`: `text`, the assistant's reply as Markdown. It is rendered again as the reply streams in, so it can end mid-sentence or inside an open `**`. The built-in renderer builds React elements and links only `http(s)`, `mailto:` and site paths. If you swap in another renderer, keep raw HTML off and check link schemes: the text comes from a model.
- Your slot can wrap the admin's own component (e.g. `Select` from `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/admin` plus a class). It gets the built-in, not itself.

## Another Markdown renderer

The assistant shows replies with a small built-in renderer (headings, lists, quotes, code, bold, italic, links). For tables or syntax highlighting, give the `Markdown` slot a library. This one uses `react-markdown`, which does not render raw HTML and drops unsafe link schemes:

```tsx filename="src/mnml/ui.tsx"
'use client';

import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import { uiProvider, type UiSlotProps } from '@n3wtou/mnml-cms/admin';

function AdminMarkdown({ text }: UiSlotProps['Markdown']) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 break-words">
      <ReactMarkdown
        components={{
          a: ({ href, children }) => (
            <a href={href} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="underline underline-offset-2">
              {children}
            </a>
          ),
          // The admin's Tailwind reset removes list markers and spacing, so put them back.
          ul: ({ children }) => <ul className="flex list-disc flex-col gap-1 pl-5">{children}</ul>,
          ol: ({ children }) => <ol className="flex list-decimal flex-col gap-1 pl-5">{children}</ol>,
        }}
      >
        {text}
      </ReactMarkdown>
    </div>
  );
}

export const AdminUi = uiProvider({ Markdown: AdminMarkdown });
```

This is the example app's slot (`example/src/mnml/ui.tsx`), which also styles code.

## Colours: the token bridge

On admin pages, shadcn's variables point at the admin's tokens. Your components look like the admin there; the rest of your site keeps its theme.

| shadcn | admin |
| --- | --- |
| `--background`, `--card`, `--popover` | `--mnml-bg` |
| `--foreground`, `--card-foreground`, `--popover-foreground`, `--accent-foreground` | `--mnml-text` |
| `--primary` / `--primary-foreground` | `--mnml-primary` / `--mnml-on-primary` |
| `--secondary` / `--secondary-foreground` | `--mnml-accent` / `--mnml-on-accent` |
| `--muted`, `--accent` | `--mnml-surface` |
| `--muted-foreground` | `--mnml-text-mute` |
| `--destructive` | `--mnml-danger` |
| `--border`, `--input` | `--mnml-line` |
| `--ring` | `--mnml-primary` |
| `--radius` | `6px` |

- Set on `:root:has(.mnml-admin)`: only pages showing the admin. Beats your `:root` and `.dark` values.
- Dark mode follows the admin's.
- Tailwind v4 shadcn (colour values). Tailwind v3 shadcn (`--primary: 222 47% 11%`, HSL channels) doesn't fit.
- Components that use other variable names keep your theme.

## Popovers in dialogs

The admin opens node forms and confirms in modal `<dialog>`s. A popover portalled to `<body>` sits under them and can't be clicked. Portal into `useAdminPortal()` instead: an element inside the open dialog, `undefined` elsewhere.

```tsx filename="src/components/ui/select.tsx"
import { useAdminPortal } from '@n3wtou/mnml-cms/admin';

export function SelectContent({ children, ...props }) {
  return (
    <SelectPrimitive.Portal container={useAdminPortal()}>
      <SelectPrimitive.Content {...props}>…</SelectPrimitive.Content>
    </SelectPrimitive.Portal>
  );
}
```

Same for Tooltip, Popover and DropdownMenu portals.

---

<!-- https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/authentication.md -->

# Authentication

## Built-in login

`auth: { password, secret }`: one shared password.

- 5 failed sign-ins lock the IP out for 15 minutes. Counted in the entries table, so it works on serverless.
- Sessions last 24 h from the last visit. The proxy renews the cookie while active.
- Changing `ADMIN_PASSWORD` or `ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET` signs everyone out. So does **Sign out everywhere** in the sidebar.

## Your own login

Auth.js, Better Auth, Clerk…: pass an adapter, with a `login` UI or a `loginUrl`.

```tsx
export const cms = createCms(config, {
  // …
  auth: {
    isAdmin: async () => (await auth.api.getSession({ headers: await headers() }))?.user.role === 'admin',
    login: <SignInWithSso />,
    signOut: async () => { await auth.api.signOut({ headers: await headers() }); },
  },
});
```

| Field | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `isAdmin` | Is the visitor an admin? The admin page and every API route call it. |
| `login` | Shown in the login card at `/admin/login`. Server or client component. |
| `loginUrl` | Instead of `login`: signed-out visitors go to your page, e.g. `'/sign-in'` |
| `signOut` | Optional |

- Build `login` with `Button`, `inputClass` etc. from `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/admin` to match the admin.
- Drop `adminProxy`: it only knows the built-in cookie.

---

<!-- https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/image-storage.md -->

# Image storage

Uploads go through a `MediaStorage` adapter, served at `<apiPath>/media/<key>` (so the store can be private) and cached for a year.

```ts
type MediaStorage = {
  put(file: File, name: string): Promise<string>;
  get(key: string): Promise<{ body: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>; contentType?: string; size?: number } | null>;
  list?(): Promise<{ key: string; size?: number; uploadedAt?: Date }[]>;
  delete?(key: string): Promise<void>;
};
```

| Method | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `put` | Stores the file, returns a unique key |
| `get` | Reads by key |
| `list` | Optional. Adds the Media screen and "Choose from uploads". |
| `delete` | Optional. Adds Delete there. |

## The Media screen

With `list`, the admin gets a **Media** screen. Per file: size, date, the entries using it (image fields and rich text images, drafts too), an "Unused" flag, Delete (warns if still used). Both bundled adapters have it.

**Select** (needs `delete`) adds a checkbox to each file and a bar with the count, **Select all**, **Select unused**, **Clear** and **Delete**. One confirmation covers the whole batch and says how many of the files are still used in entries. Files that fail to delete (the storage said no) are listed, and the rest are deleted anyway. A batch is at most 100 files per request; larger selections are sent in several.

## Choose from uploads

With `list`, an `image` field has **Choose from uploads** in its toolbar (and in the empty drop zone), and the rich text **Image** tool opens the same picker. It shows the stored files, newest first, with a search by name. Pick one to use it; **Upload new** in the picker uploads and picks in one step. A picked image starts with empty alt text and no focal point, like a new upload. Without `list` (a custom adapter that can't list files), the picker is left out and both upload as before.

## Adapters

- `vercelBlobMedia({ prefix = 'cms/', access = 'private', token })`: serves keys under `prefix` only.
- `localMedia({ dir = '.mnml-uploads' })`: disk. Default in `next dev` without `media`. Not for serverless. Gitignore the folder.
- S3, R2, anything else: write your own `put` and `get`.

---

<!-- https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/other-orms.md -->

# Other ORMs

Not Drizzle? Pass `storage` instead of `database`: five plain queries. The CMS handles caching, sorting and drafts.

```ts
type EntryStorage = {
  readRow(collection: string, slug: string): Promise<{ data: unknown; status: string } | undefined>;
  readRows(collection: string): Promise<{ slug: string; data: unknown; status: string; createdAt: Date; updatedAt: Date }[]>;
  upsert(collection: string, slug: string, data: unknown, status: string): Promise<void>;
  insertIfAbsent(collection: string, slug: string, data: unknown, status: string): Promise<boolean>;
  remove(collection: string, slug: string): Promise<void>;
  readRowsBySlug?(collection: string, slugs: string[]): Promise<{ slug: string; data: unknown; status: string }[]>;
};
```

| Method | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `upsert` | Set `updatedAt` to now. |
| `insertIfAbsent` | `false` if the slug exists. |
| `readRowsBySlug` | Optional. These slugs' rows, one query, any order. Without it, `getEntries` uses `readRows`. |

## The table

Create it yourself, with these names.

```sql
create table entries (
  id serial primary key,
  collection text not null,
  slug text not null,
  data jsonb not null,
  status text not null default 'published',
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint entries_collection_slug unique (collection, slug)
);
```

## Example: Prisma

```prisma
model Entry {
  id         Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  collection String
  slug       String
  data       Json
  status     String   @default("published")
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt  DateTime @default(now()) @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  @@unique([collection, slug], name: "entries_collection_slug")
  @@map("entries")
}
```

```ts
const at = (collection: string, slug: string) => ({ entries_collection_slug: { collection, slug } });

const storage: EntryStorage = {
  async readRow(collection, slug) {
    return (await prisma.entry.findUnique({ where: at(collection, slug), select: { data: true, status: true } })) ?? undefined;
  },
  readRows: (collection) =>
    prisma.entry.findMany({ where: { collection }, select: { slug: true, data: true, status: true, createdAt: true, updatedAt: true } }),
  async upsert(collection, slug, data, status) {
    await prisma.entry.upsert({
      where: at(collection, slug),
      create: { collection, slug, data: data as object, status },
      update: { data: data as object, status },
    });
  },
  async insertIfAbsent(collection, slug, data, status) {
    const { count } = await prisma.entry.createMany({ data: [{ collection, slug, data: data as object, status }], skipDuplicates: true });
    return count > 0;
  },
  async remove(collection, slug) {
    await prisma.entry.deleteMany({ where: { collection, slug } });
  },
  readRowsBySlug: (collection, slugs) =>
    prisma.entry.findMany({ where: { collection, slug: { in: slugs } }, select: { slug: true, data: true, status: true } }),
};
```

`drizzle-orm` is still a peer dependency: install it anyway.

<!-- https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/entry-points.md -->

# Entry points

| Import | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `@n3wtou/mnml-cms` | Schema builders, validation, types, `seoMetadata`. Framework-free. |
| `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/next` | `createCms` (with the MCP server, see [Agents](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/agents.md)), `neonDatabase`, `drizzleStorage`, `vercelBlobMedia`, `localMedia` |
| `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/proxy` | `adminProxy` |
| `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/rich-text` | `RichText` (server renderer), `collectReferences` |
| `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/editor` | `defineEditor`, `tools` (incl. `tools.node`, `tools.reference`), `nodeAttributes`, `referenceNode`, `collectReferences`, types `RichTextComponents`, `RichTextNodeProps`. Server-safe. |
| `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/table` | `tables`: table extensions and buttons. Server-safe. |
| `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/admin` | UI for extra admin pages (`Button`, `Input`, `Select`, `Checkbox`, `Switch`, `Tooltip`, `useAdmin`), `editorProvider` ([Options](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/options.md#admin-ui-components)) |
| `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/sync` | Export/import, `mediaImporter`, `markdownToRichText` ([Moving content](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/moving-content.md)). No Next.js needed. |
| `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/db`, `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/schema` | The Drizzle table, for scripts and drizzle-kit (same export) |
| `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/styles.css` | Admin styles and the `--mnml-*` variables |

---

<!-- https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/common-mistakes.md -->

# Common mistakes

## Imports

- `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/next` is server-only. It fails in plain scripts (`tsx`). Scripts use `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/db` for the table and `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/sync` for content.
- `mnml.config.ts` is plain data. Import it anywhere, client components too.

## Values

- An `image` is `{ url, alt } | null`, not a string. Use `.url`, and pass `alt` to the `<img>`.
- Never write media URLs by hand. Upload, or use `mediaImporter` ([Moving content](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/moving-content.md)).
- Blank inputs are stored as `null` for `date`, `url`, `number`, `select` and `reference`. `boolean` ignores `required`.
- A `reference` stores a slug only. Read it with `getEntry`. Nothing checks that the entry still exists.

- Changing a field's type while entries hold content is safe: the admin shows the old value and asks. See [Changing fields](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/changing-fields.md).

## Blocks and conditional fields

- `kind` is reserved in blocks. A block can't have a field named `kind`.
- A block removed from the config is dropped from entries on read.
- `showIf` hides a field, it doesn't delete it. Hidden fields keep their value and skip validation. Readers still return it, so check the same condition on the page.

## Drafts

- Public readers return published entries only. A draft is a 404 on the site.
- Edits to an existing entry autosave as a draft. They go live on Publish only.
- A singleton publishes on Save, unless it has `drafts: true`.
- Render `<cms.PreviewBanner />` in the site layout, or editors can't leave preview.

## Routes and layout

- `apiPath` is `/api/mnml`. Sites upgraded from before 1.0.0 with uploaded images keep `apiPath: '/api/cms'`, or those images 404.
- Next.js 16 names the middleware file `proxy.ts`.
- Keep the admin out of the site's header and footer: put them in a route group layout, e.g. `app/(site)/layout.tsx`.

## After upgrading the package

Restart the dev server (`rm -rf .next`) and your editor's TypeScript server. Stale types and hot-reload state look like real errors.

---

<!-- https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/upgrading.md -->

# Upgrading

Check the installed version first:

```sh
grep '"version"' node_modules/@n3wtou/mnml-cms/package.json
```

Upgrade one major at a time. Run the type check after each, and click through `/admin` before moving on. The [changelog](https://github.com/mbuguanewton/mnml-cms/blob/main/packages/cms/CHANGELOG.md) has every release.

## Versions

| Version | Adds | Breaking |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0.1.0 | Initial release: singletons and collections; `text`, `textarea`, `date`, `url`, `image` (a string), `richtext`, `tags`, `array`; password login; Postgres JSON table. | |
| 0.2.0 | `select`, `boolean`, `number`, `reference`, `group`, `seo()` and `seoMetadata()`; `derived` values (`derive`, `plainText`, `readingTime`); `listEntries(key, { orderBy, order, filter, limit, offset })`; draft/published status for collections; `storage` option (own `EntryStorage`, e.g. Prisma); Media screen; `AuthAdapter`; login lockout; image alt text. | New `status` column (run `drizzle-kit push`). Public readers hide drafts, and `listEntries` returns `status`. `image` is `{ url, alt } \| null` (stored strings still read). Sessions are 24 hours and the cookie format changed. |
| 1.0.0 | `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/editor` (`defineEditor`, extra Tiptap extensions and toolbar tools), `editorProvider`, `<RichText editor>`; grouped toolbar; headings 1–4. | Everything `cms-*` became `mnml-*`: CSS variables (`--mnml-*`), classes, Tailwind tokens; default `apiPath` is `/api/mnml` (was `/api/cms`); upload folder `.mnml-uploads`; cookies `mnml_session` and `mnml_preview`. |
| 1.1.0 | `fields.blocks()` and `block()`; `showIf` on any field. | |
| 1.2.0 | Autosave drafts, Discard changes, `drafts: true` on singletons; block picker (`description`, `addLabel`); sign-in form no longer puts the password in the URL. | No "Save draft" button. Behaviour change only; no API or database change. |
| 1.3.0 | `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/sync`: content export and import between databases. | |
| 1.4.0 | `fields.references()` + `cms.getEntries()`; `fields.datetime()`; `default` on fields + `initialValues()`; select option labels + `selectLabel()`; `min` / `max` on `array` / `blocks` / `references`; combobox entry pickers; `<RichText components>` and `defineEditor({ components })`; `tools.node()` + `nodeAttributes()`; `tools.reference()`, `referenceNode()`, `collectReferences()`; tool `visible` / `context`; `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/table` (`tables`); `mediaImporter()` / `importRemoteMedia()` in `/sync`; image focal point (`focalX` / `focalY`) + `focalPosition()`. | No API or database change. `required` on `array` / `blocks` now means at least one item; the package's toolbar tools come before the site's own in each group. |
| 1.4.1 | Docs moved to https://mnml-cms.vercel.app; the README covers install and setup only. | No code change. |
| 1.5.0 | MCP server for agents (`mcp` option, scoped tokens, approval of deletes and discards, Markdown rich text); `listEntries` returns `createdAt` / `updatedAt`; `change.by`; `markdownToRichText()` / `richTextToMarkdown()` in `/sync`; MCP `docs` tool, docs pages as `.md`, `AGENTS.md` in the package. | No API or database change. |
| 1.6.0 | Agent tokens from the admin (`mcp.adminTokens`); own admin controls (`Select`, `Checkbox`, `Switch`, `Tooltip`, toasts, `Menu`); `ui` option + `uiProvider()` to use your own components (e.g. shadcn) with a token bridge, `useAdminPortal()`, `mnml-admin` class; own date picker (`DatePicker`, time inside the calendar); rich text toolbar overflow menu, fullscreen editor, resizable inline editor; collection list paging and search. | The Drizzle schema file moved: `drizzle.config.ts` must use `schema: './node_modules/@n3wtou/mnml-cms/dist/server/content/db.js'` (was `dist/server/db.js`). No database change. Native selects, checkboxes, date and time popups are replaced by the admin's own, so CSS targeting those native elements in the admin may need a look. |
| 1.7.0 | Collection list filters (`filters`) and sortable columns (`columns`), a Columns menu for editors (`columnChoices`); row selection with bulk Publish, Unpublish, Delete and your own actions (`listActions`); "Choose from uploads" picker and multiselect delete on the Media page; "Create new" for `reference` and `references` fields (side panel, `createNew: false` to turn off); new `image` field design (drop zone, toolbar over the preview, focal point in place); `brand: { name, logo }`; Revoke on config tokens in Agent access. | No API or database change. Editors' column choices are saved in a `mnml_cols_<collection>` cookie. The collection list now uses the full page width. The Drizzle schema path is `dist/server/content/db.js` (since 1.6.0). |
| 1.8.0 | Drag to reorder rows in `array`, `blocks` and `references` fields (a grip replaces the up and down arrows; keyboard: ↑ ↓ Home End); new `cache` option to keep published reads between requests (`cache: true`, expired by each save or delete). | No API or database change. `cache` is off by default: turn it on with `createCms(config, { cache: true })`. Content written outside the CMS (`db:import`, `sync`, SQL) shows up after the cache's `revalidate` time (default 3600 seconds). |
| 1.9.0 | Changing a field while entries hold content: the admin shows the old value beside the new field (**Use this**, **Remove**) and waits before saving ([Changing fields](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/changing-fields.md)); entries that crashed the admin (`date`, `references`, `image` holding the wrong kind of value) open; the "Add section" list and the entry picker no longer push the page. | No API or database change. **Readers now return the field's empty value for a stored value that doesn't fit its field**, instead of passing it through; `next dev` logs a warning for each. Valid entries read as before. If your site relied on a wrongly typed stored value, fix the entry in the admin. |

## Upgrade steps

**0.1.x → 0.2.0**
1. Add the `status` column before deploying: `drizzle-kit push` against each database. Existing rows stay published.
2. Search the code for `image` fields used as a URL string and change them to `.url` (add `alt={…alt}`).
3. Draft entries now 404 publicly. That's expected.
4. Everyone signs in once.

**0.2.x → 1.0.0**
1. Rename CSS variables, classes and Tailwind tokens (`--cms-*`, `cms-prose`, `cms-root`, `cms-state`,
   `bg-cms-*`, `text-cms-*`, `font-cms-brand`) to `mnml-*`.
2. Either move `app/api/cms/[...route]/route.ts` to `app/api/mnml/[...route]/route.ts`, or keep
   `apiPath: '/api/cms'` in `createCms` (required if images were uploaded before, since their URLs contain `/api/cms/media/`).
3. Rename `.cms-uploads` to `.mnml-uploads` (and its `.gitignore` line).
4. Headings in rich text now go 1–4: add styles for `h1` and `h4`.
5. Editors sign in again.

**1.5.x → 1.6.0**
1. In `drizzle.config.ts`, change `schema` to `'./node_modules/@n3wtou/mnml-cms/dist/server/content/db.js'`. The old `dist/server/db.js` is gone, so `drizzle-kit push` fails until you do. The `@n3wtou/mnml-cms/db` and `/schema` imports are unchanged.
2. If your admin CSS targets native selects, checkboxes or date and time inputs, check `/admin`.

**1.0 → 1.x:** no breaking changes. 1.2.0 changes how editors save drafts, which is worth telling them. 1.4.0: check `required: true` on `array` / `blocks` fields, since entries with an empty list won't save until an item is added.

## What a project has

```sh
grep -n "blocks:\|showIf\|select:\|number:" node_modules/@n3wtou/mnml-cms/dist/define.d.ts node_modules/@n3wtou/mnml-cms/dist/schema/define.d.ts 2>/dev/null
ls node_modules/@n3wtou/mnml-cms/dist/sync.js node_modules/@n3wtou/mnml-cms/dist/sync/index.js 2>/dev/null  # 1.3.0+
ls node_modules/@n3wtou/mnml-cms/dist/table-entry.js node_modules/@n3wtou/mnml-cms/dist/editor/tables.js 2>/dev/null  # 1.4.0+
grep -rn "apiPath" src app 2>/dev/null | head                  # a kept '/api/cms'?
```
